title: Chef's Market Food Hall
venue_description:
Chef's Market Food Hall and Entertainment Venue

Overview

Chef's Market is a premier food hall and entertainment destination located in City Center at Oyster Point in Newport News. The venue opened as a comprehensive dining and entertainment complex featuring multiple food vendors a full-service butcher shop retail options a brewery and distillery and extensive gaming and entertainment amenities. The space represents a modern approach to casual dining and social gathering with an emphasis on local quality ingredients and craft beverages.

Food and Beverage

The venue offers an impressive array of dining options with multiple food stalls serving everything from gourmet grilled cheese sandwiches and smashburgers to creative tacos pizza and other comfort foods. A dedicated cheese bar features artisanal selections and a butcher counter provides premium meats and seafood. Chef Kenny Sloanes Chef's Life Brewery and Distillery produces small-batch craft beers monthly releases and handcrafted cocktails featuring quality ingredients and attention to flavor. Coffee bar service is also available throughout the venue.

Entertainment and Atmosphere

Beyond dining Chef's Market provides extensive entertainment options including duck pin bowling darts shuffleboard and arcade games. The open airy layout with modern decor creates a lively social atmosphere ideal for groups and social occasions. The venue regularly hosts live music events on weekends and features weekly acoustic open mic performances on Thursday evenings showcasing local singer-songwriters and musicians. Karaoke nights add to the entertainment programming making it a dynamic venue for various types of gatherings.

Community Space

Chef's Market serves as a community gathering place where residents can enjoy quality food craft beverages games and live music. The combination of diverse food options craft beverages entertainment games and regular music programming creates a versatile venue that appeals to a wide audience. It has become a popular destination for date nights group outings sports viewing and casual entertainment in the Newport News area.

title: Cure Coffeehouse
venue_description:
Cure Coffeehouse Newport News

Overview

Cure Coffeehouse is an independent specialty coffee shop located in City Center Newport News that has become a beloved community gathering space and cultural venue. The cafe features high-quality craft coffee and espresso prepared by skilled baristas alongside made-from-scratch baked goods fresh breakfast items and lunch selections. The spacious comfortable interior with large windows overlooking fountains in the Town Center plaza creates an inviting atmosphere for work socializing and enjoying beverages and food.

Beverage and Food Program

Cure offers a carefully curated selection of specialty coffee drinks including cortados lattes cappuccinos and single-origin pour-overs using Counter Culture Coffee's Big Trouble espresso as the base. All espresso-based beverages feature a double shot standard base and can be customized with various syrups and milk options. The food program includes made-from-scratch baked goods such as molasses cookies scones and pastries alongside breakfast sandwiches with creative combinations like bacon cheddar and fried egg on toasted bagels. Lunch offerings feature items like turkey and fig sandwiches with goat cheese and fresh preparations like tomato bisque soup.

Live Music and Cultural Programming

Cure Coffeehouse hosts a renowned weekly open mic night every Thursday evening from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM that serves as a cornerstone of the Newport News arts and music community. The event welcomes all performance styles including folk singer-songwriter music poetry spoken word alternative and experimental arrangements. Host Austin Milby has cultivated the event since 2017 creating an intentionally inclusive welcoming space that celebrates emerging and seasoned performers equally. The open mic attracts a diverse community including LGBTQ+ artists and musicians of all backgrounds and experience levels.

Community and Inclusivity

The venue is deliberately designed to be a safe inclusive and welcoming space for all visitors. Staff members are trained to approach guests with genuine hospitality and the storefront visibly supports LGBTQ+ inclusion with pride flags and an LGBTQ+-majority staff. The open mic community has evolved to support various art forms including musician visual artists poets and storytellers. The venue provides opportunities for visual artists to sell and exhibit their work. Cure represents the kind of independent coffee shop that prioritizes community connection over corporate efficiency making it an authentic neighborhood hub cherished by Newport News residents.

title: Downing-Gross Cultural Arts Center
venue_description:
Downing-Gross Cultural Arts Center

History and Architecture

The Downing-Gross Cultural Arts Center is housed in a historic building originally constructed in 1917 as the Walter Reed School in Newport News' Southeast community. The structure has been meticulously restored and reopened to the public in October 2008 as a multi-purpose cultural venue. The restored historic building now serves as a vibrant hub for arts and cultural programming honoring the citys heritage while supporting contemporary artistic expression.

Performance Spaces

The centerpiece of the facility is the Ella Fitzgerald Theater a 276-seat professional performance venue named after the legendary First Lady of Song and Newport News native. The theater provides excellent acoustics and comfortable seating for theatrical performances concerts and cultural events. The building also contains meeting rooms and gathering spaces that accommodate various types of events and community activities.

Gallery Spaces and Visual Arts

The facility features three distinct gallery spaces for visual arts programming. The Anderson Johnson Gallery presents a permanent exhibit celebrating the life and work of legendary folk artist Anderson Johnson whose influential work impacted the Newport News community. The Newport News Community Gallery serves as a rotating exhibition space showcasing works by local and national contemporary visual artists. The Foyer Gallery provides additional exhibition space for community-based art displays and installations.

Music and Performance Programming

Downing-Gross hosts the 25 Mics monthly open mic series held on the second Tuesday of each month at 7:00 PM in the Newport News Community Gallery. This free family-friendly event welcomes musicians poets comedians storytellers and performers of all backgrounds and skill levels. The host Quinton Q5 Jennings-Sherman creates an inclusive environment celebrating local talent and community creativity. The open mic accepts performers on a first-come-first-served basis with sign-ups available at the event.

Educational and Community Programming

Beyond performance and gallery exhibitions the center offers instructional spaces including the Thaddeus Hayes Dance Studio art studio music room and other classroom facilities. Programs include instruction in visual arts dance music and theater with registration available through the citys recreation department. The facility hosts Write Now Literary Festival events summer programming exhibitions and auditions supporting various artistic disciplines.

Community Mission

Downing-Gross Cultural Arts Center is operated as a facility of the City of Newport News Parks and Recreation Department with a mission to promote cultural awareness provide opportunities for local artists and foster participation from all community members. The center welcomes visitors during regular business hours for gallery viewing and provides rental options for private events. It stands as a testament to Newport News' commitment to preserving cultural heritage while nurturing contemporary artistic expression and community engagement.
